summary.zh: 塔会自己开火，玩家决定它先解决哪一种威胁。
summary.en: The tower fires automatically; the player decides which threat it addresses first.

rules.zh: 玩家为防御单位选择目标规则，例如优先打最前面的敌人或最强的敌人。规则持续生效，直到玩家更改；射线、目标标记和漏怪结果帮助判断分工。目标选择仍受射程、攻击类型和是否能发现目标限制。
rules.en: Choose a target rule, such as the enemy closest to escaping or the strongest enemy. The rule persists until changed; projectiles, target markers and leaks show its effects. Range, attack type and detection still constrain eligible targets.

loop.zh: 观察队列里的不同威胁
loop.en: Inspect the different threats in the line

decisions.zh: 先清掉出口前的小怪，还是让重火力持续打高血量敌人？
decisions.en: Remove small enemies near the exit or keep heavy weapons on a durable target?

decisions.zh: 所有塔打同一个强敌可能浪费伤害，分工又可能让强敌活着走出射程。
decisions.en: All towers focusing one threat can waste damage; splitting them may let it leave their range alive.

effect.zh: 免费切换鼓励临场指挥；有冷却时更重视波次前的判断。
effect.en: Free switching rewards active direction; a cooldown emphasizes decisions before a wave.

effect.zh: 先给少量能看出差异的规则，过多细分会增加理解和操作负担。
effect.en: Start with a few visibly different rules; many subtle rules raise reading and control costs.

contrast.zh: 气球塔防把优先级叠在猴塔的既有升级上；宝石争霸还把它与宝石效果搭配，使控制效果的投放对象也很重要。
contrast.en: Bloons layers priorities onto tower upgrades; GemCraft also couples them to gem effects, making the recipient of control effects matter.

combination.zh: 组合提案：让库存传感器控制塔的策略，弹药少时优先拦截出口附近的敌人，库存恢复后再处理重甲目标。
combination.en: Design proposal: let an inventory sensor switch tower priorities: intercept imminent leaks when ammunition is low, then target armored threats after resupply.

setup.zh: 一只慢速大怪在后面，三只小怪快到出口。
setup.en: One slow large enemy follows three small enemies nearing the exit.

action.zh: 让速射塔打最前面的敌人，让重炮继续打大怪。
action.en: Set the rapid-fire tower to the first enemy and leave the cannon on the strongest.

result.zh: 小怪被及时清理，重炮没有浪费大伤害去补最后一点血。
result.en: Small enemies are intercepted without wasting heavy shots on nearly dead targets.

next.zh: 下一波换成成群小怪，再检查这套分工是否还合适。
next.en: Reassess the division of labor when the next wave is a swarm.

firstStep.zh: 先做一条路、两座塔和“最前/最高血量”两个规则。
firstStep.en: Start with one lane, two towers and two rules: furthest along and highest health.

pitfall.zh: 目标标记和射程必须清楚，否则玩家会以为塔没有听指令。
pitfall.en: Make target markers and range explicit, or players may think the tower ignored them.

test.zh: 同一布局只换优先级，玩家能否预测哪类敌人更容易漏掉？
test.en: Can a player predict which enemies escape when only the priorities change?
